main_measure.name: mean 10-bar forward return on fresh-death-cross bars minus coin's mean 10-bar return
main_measure.threshold: confirm if above 0 with t >= +2 and supporting check positive; reject if below 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: allocation-weighted 1-bar return on regime bars minus coin's mean 1-bar return

decided_by: Enough events and blocks, but the numbers meet neither the confirm rule nor the reject rule (t between -2 and +2, or confirm's supporting check not positive).
reading: Regime bars are those labelled mean_reversion, blocks are the window grid bars 0,10,20,... on those bars, holding is the coin's mean grid 10-bar return over all its windows, an event is one contiguous run of regime bars in a window and the clustered t uses the CR1 cluster variance of the mean, both minimums (15 events and 30 blocks) must be reached, and the supporting check is sum(alloc x (1-bar return - coin's mean 1-bar return)) / sum(alloc) over regime bars.
